title: Replying to @Stephanie B (btw the caption on that original video was ...
transcript: when I was in theatre school I was in a constant state of crisis and one of my professors said something to me that I'll never forget and that I'm thinking about especially today I had this idea that I wanted to be an artist and in some ways I did but I found myself instinctually and inexorably drawn to theatre-going, to being on the audience side even when it came at the expense of pursuing artistic opportunities and training because I was just devoting so much time to it not only voraciously consuming the theater itself but also keeping a private theater journal as I still do today where I was rigorously honing my ability to talk about theatre in an articulate and thoughtful way it would take a few years out in the real world for me to realize it but I think even then I knew deep down that being a professional artist was not the path for me partly just because I really like the stability of having a 9 to 5 job but also because I was already following my bliss I was already making choices about how to spend my time and theatre-going is always taking priority still though if there was any living wage profession that felt more out of reach than being an artist it was being a theatre critic especially if I wanted to also be an artist without burning bridges so like I said I was in a constant state of crisis about this for a lot of years but I had one professor who was really supportive of me and actually still is to this day and on one of the many occasions where I sat in his office seeking guidance the thing he said to me that I'll never forget was: “Joe, you are honing a skill” “and you're building up a store of knowledge and experience” “it will not go unused” “and it will not go unnoticed” it took a long time and a lot of life changes for his words to come true but with TikTok I now feel like it's not going unused and as of last year I am an awards voter for the Outer Critics Circle and as of last night I hit 10k followers on here and I feel like it's not going unnoticed so thank you all for noticing especially because I did in fact beat my goal of “10k by Turkey Day” by a pretty wide margin in fact I actually beat my original secret goal originally I had set the loose goal for myself of “10k by Labor Day” but when it seemed like that wasn't gonna happen I actually changed the goal to 10k by Turkey Day but now here we are a couple weeks before Labor Day so again thank you and as a fun little walk down memory lane I'll finish off with the first video I ever posted on here hello my name is Joe and this is my first TikTok so mazel tov to me! I live in New York and I see a lot of theatre especially a lot of plays especially a lot of off Broadway shows but uh I see generally just a lot of theatre and I figured since most of the people who follow me on other social media platforms don't really care about that stuff I would start posting stuff on TikTok so until I learn how to end a TikTok I'll end it the same way that I end my emails “thanks a bunch!” “best, Joe”
